newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's King Hussein, Egypt's Mubarak to meet.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein, Egypt's Mubarak to meet.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak will meet for talks in Jordan's Red Sea port of Aqaba on Saturday, officials said on Thursday.
The two leaders, who have both tried to revive flagging PLO-Israeli talks over Palestinian self-rule, are expected to discuss the troubled Middle East peace process.
They are due to hold talks at the royal seaside palace.
Officials said no other leaders would be present at the Mubarak-King Hussein meeting.
Palestinian talks with Israel stalled in March after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu started work on a Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem.
Palestinians want East Jerusalem to be the capital of a future state and say that settlement building pre-empts talks on a final settlement with Israel.
